objections.claim: The two-phase transition deadlocks at Phase B. A5 defines the closed pre-activation whitelist as {E1, freshness, plugin self-containment, E2, E3, E6, E4, product memory/ADRs, naming/versions}, omitting the excluded-dirs/atomic-activation PR. Section 6 then requires the controller to enforce whitelist membership for every subsequent merge, and §§3/6 state that only whitelisted slices are merge-eligible until Phase B completes. Because the Phase-B PR must merge while Phase B is not yet complete, the controller must reject it as `slice-not-whitelisted`, so activation can never occur. Add the uniquely content-addressed Phase-B atomic-activation slice to A5's whitelist, constrained as its terminal transition entry, and add a regression proving it is accepted while every other unlisted PR remains refused.
